name: fleet-epic
description: claude-fleet EPIC batches: /fleet-epic-plan turns a theme into a confirmed batch — a parent hub task — and /fleet-epic-run drives its child tasks to done, /fleet-epic-report writes what it did — on one shared page frame; /fleet-task-plan gives one task the same design page (T661). Its driver dispatches with the core's tools (issue #4334). Not installed by default (EPIC #3111).
